
QUERY-WORK-UNITS
Query work units with advanced filters and output formats

USAGE
  fspec query-work-units [options]

OPTIONS
  --status <status>
    Filter by status
  --type <type>
    Filter by work unit type: story, task, or bug
  --tag <tag>
    Filter by tag (e.g., @cli, @high)
  --epic <epic>
    Filter by epic
  --prefix <prefix>
    Filter by prefix
  --format <format>
    Output format: table, json, csv

EXAMPLES
  1. Query with filters
  $ fspec query-work-units --status=implementing --format=json
  [{"id":"AUTH-001","status":"implementing","title":"Login feature"}]

  2. Query completed stories tagged with @cli
  $ fspec query-work-units --type=story --status=done --tag=@cli
  [{"id":"CLI-001","status":"done","title":"CLI commands"}]

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec list-work-units
  fspec export-work-units
  fspec search-scenarios
  fspec compare-implementations
